tools.name: search_designs
tools.description: Karved's own ready-made cup designs (gifts, hobbies, jobs, holidays, full wraps) matching the words given. Returns title, product page url, price per cup, image and a short description. The art is fixed; many designs take an optional name ($3 once per name and cup colour) on the product page. No art

tools.name: list_cups
tools.description: The cups you can design on: blank_shape_id, name, colours, print coverages and fonts. Call this first.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Put the customer's logo (and up to 2 text lines) on a cup. Returns design_id, design_version, an artwork check (preflight) and a mockup_url. Upload the customer's own file as base64 (PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF, up to 25 MB). Partner agent keys may pass an idempotency_key so a retry does not make a second

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The posted price for a quantity of this design (cups + art prep fee, no shipping). For 50 or more, full wraps not sold online, or business accounts it returns quote_required: then use request_quote.

tools.name: get_mockup
tools.description: A mockup image URL of the design on the cup, optionally in another colour of the same cup. A preview, not a proof.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send this design, quantity and the customer's contact to Karved for a quote and proof. Only call it after the customer agreed. Our team replies by email within one business day. Nothing is charged or ordered.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_designs, get_mockup · Private data: create_design, request_quote · Public sink: search_designs, create_design, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_designs, get_mockup · Private data: create_design, request_quote · Public sink: search_designs, create_design, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
